@aehlig I've checked again at head, the error message is still the same.

> ERROR: Failed to load Starlark extension '@antlr4_runtime//:rules.bzl'.

If possible, show the location (line of the `load`).

> It usually happens when the repository is not defined prior to being used.

Usually? What are the other reasons?

> ERROR: cycles detected during target parsing

This message is confusing. I don't think there's actually a cycle here.

If helpful, the relevant part of the WORKSPACE looks like [this](https://github.com/batfish/batfish/blob/master/WORKSPACE#L26-L37).

```
# ANTLR 4 Runtime
maven_repository(
    name = "antlr4_runtime",
    transitive_deps = [
        "e27d8ab4f984f9d186f54da984a6ab1cccac755e:org.antlr:antlr4-runtime:4.7.2",
    ],
    deps = [
        "org.antlr:antlr4-runtime:4.7.2",
    ],
)

load("@antlr4_runtime//:rules.bzl", "antlr4_runtime_compile")
```

The load here is defined by the `maven_repository` rule immediately before it. I do not know how to see:

* whether that `maven_repository` rule succeeded or failed
* what that `maven_repository` rule produced, if it succeeded
* what is in the `@antlr4_runtime` space, if anything -- this failure causes the entire `bazel-<foo>` subtrees to not be created (more likely, to be deleted before I have a chance to look).

How do folks debug these types of issues?

> > ERROR: cycles detected during target parsing
> 
> This message is confusing. I don't think there's actually a cycle here.

Note that this message is from Skyframe and technically correct: if a repository is to be loaded, that depends on knowing the definition of the repository; searching for the definition of a repository works by evaluating the `WORKSPACE` file chunk by chunk till the definition is found—and evaluating that chunk requires evaluating the `load` statement first.

OK, debug-printing the full cycle at least shows what's going on.

```
cycle=[[/tmp/batfish]/[WORKSPACE], 3, @antlr4_runtime//:rules.bzl (in workspace), CONTAINING_PACKAGE_LOOKUP:@antlr4_runtime//, PACKAGE_LOOKUP:@antlr4_runtime//, REPOSITORY:@antlr4_runtime, REPOSITORY_DIRECTORY:@antlr4_runtime, PACKAGE_LOOKUP:@gradle_distribution//, REPOSITORY:@gradle_distribution, REPOSITORY_DIRECTORY:@gradle_distribution]
pathToCycle=[[//tools/...] EXPAND_TEST_SUITES com.google.devtools.build.lib.pkgcache.TestFilter@e17a1, PACKAGE:external, EXTERNAL_PACKAGE:[/tmp/batfish]/[WORKSPACE]]
```

The `maven_repository` has an implicit dependency on `@gradle_distribution` which apparently is not met (i.e., for some reason, `maven_repositories` failed to define the `gradle_distribution` repository.

From an error-message point of view, we probably should show the full cycle (or, at least, all the repositories involved).

Thanks! That unblocked me.
